name: Rastriya Arogya Nidhi - Health Minister’s Cancer Patient Fund
benefit:

> ***Note:*** 

- _Individual cases, which require assistance of more than_  ₹5,00,000/- _will be sent to the Ministry for processing._-  _The maximum financial assistance admissible under the Scheme will be ₹15,00,000/-_
